sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows calcium chloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, has a calcium chloride injection entry with status To Be Discontinued and an initial posting date of 2025-11-07.
The Hospira label for NDC 00409163110 identifies a registered plant at FEI 1021343 with a last inspection classification of NAI on 2025-02-07.
That plant received multiple OAI classifications in 2010 and 2011 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12, but its most recent inspection was NAI.
Corvale East holds 459 syringes at 15.6 per day for 29.4 days on hand; Corvale General holds 245 syringes at 15.1 per day for 16.2 days on hand.
The rule-based top option is to buy from ICU Medical Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
